label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows directly to HTML response writer at line 23. The length check using init parameter display.maxLen (default 64) does not sanitize or encode the input - it only truncates. Standard XSS payloads like fit within 64 chars and remain executable. Resolved sink value: {user_input} where user_input is attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User input param flows to HTML output without encoding; length check does not prevent XSS
